tasks.label: Run
args: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -scheme FVoice -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build build && { pkill -x FVoice; sleep 0.5; open build/Build/Products/Debug/FVoice.app; }

tasks.label: Release
args: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -scheme FVoice -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build build && { pkill -x FVoice; sleep 0.5; open build/Build/Products/Release/FVoice.app; }
